task.instruction: Complete the dataset publication workflow. Each named step is persistent: a step only counts when its status is complete at termination. Advance a step from pending to ready before completing it; some steps require an evidence note before completion. Later steps are gated by the immediately preceding completed step. Reversing a completed step is legal and removes that progress. Persistent requirements: source-audit is complete and remains complete at termination. test-suite is complete and remains complete at termination. package is complete and remains complete at termination. signoff is complete and remains complete at termination. release-note is complete and remains complete at termination.
